title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Josh Johnson preparing to start at quarterback against Chiefs Sunday
items.desc: Josh Johnson is preparing to start at quarterback in Week 11 for the Arizona Cardinals against the Kansas City Chiefs according to Josh Weinfuss.
items.impact: Johnson could potentially make the start at quarterback after Carson Beck (back) was added to the injury report Thursday, facing a difficult task against a strong Kansas City defense Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Carson Beck (back) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Carson Beck (back) is not practicing Friday for the Arizona Cardinals according to Josh Weinfuss.
items.impact: Beck was added to the injury report due to the back issue Thursday, with the Cardinals preparing veteran Josh Johnson to potentially start under center against the Kansas City Chiefs Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) to be activated, remain sidelined
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) will be added to the active roster, but is not close to returning to the field for the Los Angeles Rams according to Adam Grosbard.
items.impact: Ferguson continues to work back from multiple injuries, but due to the numerous injury issues facing the Los Angeles Rams, the organization will shuffle the tight end back to the active roster. He can remain off rosters in all formats while continuing his rehab.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return Week 13
items.desc: Davante Adams (hamstring) could return in Week 13 for the Los Angeles Rams according to Michael J. Duarte.
items.impact: Adams continues to recover from hamstring surgery, but has progressed enough to potentially return sooner than later for a shorthanded Rams passing attack. The veteran wideout would slide into a WR1 role for head coach Sean McVay with Puka Nacua potentially out for the remainder of the season upon his return.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Christian Benford (groin) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Christian Benford (groin) was not seen practicing for the Buffalo Bills Friday according to Joe Buscaglia.
items.impact: Benford has been unable to practice to this point for head coach Joe Brady, leaving the cornerback's availability in question for Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) was not seen practicing for the Buffalo Bills according to Joe Buscaglia.
items.impact: Kincaid has struggled to reach the practice field for head coach Joe Brady to this point in the week, putting the tight end's status for Week 11 in serious jeopardy. Dawson Knox would be line for increased snaps in a TE1 role if Kincaid is unable to suit up Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Puka Nacua (MCL) could miss remainder of season
items.desc: Puka Nacua will undergo MCL surgery and could potentially miss the remainder of the season for the Los Angeles Rams according to Adam Schefter.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Darren Waller (knee) practicing again Friday
items.desc: Darren Waller (knee) was active at Friday's practice session.
items.impact: Waller missed practice back on Wednesday, but he has taken part in each of the last two days. The veteran TE should be good to go Sunday against the Ravens.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tommy Tremble (knee) practicing Friday
items.desc: Tommy Tremble (knee) takes part in Friday's practice.
items.impact: Tremble did not practice Wednesday, but he has been on the field each of the past two days. He should be good to go in Week 11, but his status should be monitored ahead of the game. Tremble has caught four passes in each of the last two games and scored back in Week 9.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: C.J. Stroud fires three more touchdowns strikes in Week 11 win
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 21-of-27 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 26-3 blowout of the Colts.
items.impact: Stroud added 27 yards on six carries to round out another impressive effort Thursday night. The fourth-year QB is completely dialed in right now, as he's thrown multiple touchdowns in five straight games, with at least three TD passes in four of them. During this run, Stroud has posted a 63.6% completion rate while averaging right around 250 yards per game with a 16-4 TD/INT ratio. He is a certain QB1 in standard formats

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: David Montgomery goes over 100 yards in return
items.desc: David Montgomery gained 107 yards on 26 carries, adding 17 yards on three receptions in Thursday's 26-3 rout of the Colts.
items.impact: So much for easing back in after a four-game absence, as Montgomery got 29 touches in an impressive workhorse effort Thursday night. The veteran back went over 100 yards for the first time this season, and he looks plenty primed for the stretch run. Montgomery is right back in the RB2 range for standard formats.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Emari Demercado gets seven touches in Thursday's win
items.desc: Emari Demercado gained 33 yards on five carries and caught two passes for negative yardage in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: With Woody Marks (concussion) out, Demercado was the top backup in the Texans' backfield again this week. This time, he was behind returning starter David Montgomery, who had missed the previous four games due to a groin injury. Demercado was productive with the work he got, but Montgomery shouldered a workhorse load even in his first game back.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Nico Colins scores again in Week 11
items.desc: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Collins has now scored in three straight games and is up to six touchdown grabs over eight games this season. C.J. Stroud spread out his passes in this one, so Collins ended up with just a third of Week 10's season-high total in receptions. Still, fantasy managers won't be complaining due to the touchdown. Collins remains a steady WR1.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tank Dell hauls in three passes Thursday night
items.desc: Tank Dell secured 3-of-4 targets for 27 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Dell has now caught at least three passes in each of the last three weeks, but his signature big plays have not been there for the most part over the last two games. Still, he has been on the field for just about half of the Texans' offensive snaps over the last three games, and he always has the potential to take one to the house at any point. Dell moves forward as a volatile, big-play receiver for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Xavier Hutchinson finishes with 13 yards in Week 11 win
items.desc: Xavier Hutchinson caught 2-of-3 targets for only 13 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: After scoring in three straight games, Hutchinson was disappointing for fantasy managers who hoped his hot streak would continue Thursday night. Hutchinson is consistently involved in the Texans' passing attack, but his ceiling is significantly limited in his current role. The fourth-year receiver has caught between 2 and 4 passes in all 10 games so far this season.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kayshon Boutte hits paydirt in Week 11 win
items.desc: Kayshon Boutte hauled in both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Despite exiting the game early due to a hip issue, Boutte caught his third TD of the season Thursday night. It's difficult to project Boutte week-to-week, as he caught his previous two touchdown passes in Week 9 only to post a goose egg in Week 10. The 24-year-old speedster fits the boom-or-bust label quite well.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Marlin Klein scores first career touchdown Thursday night
items.desc: Marlin Klein caught all four of his targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Seeing his first targets since Week 1, Klein was plenty active in the Texans' passing game Thursday night, catching one of QB C.J. Stroud's three TD strikes. Klein played about a quarter of the Texans' offensive snaps, and the second-round rookie could be on his way to a bigger role down the stretch.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) will not play in Week 11
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Cooper played just one snap in Week 10 after being questionable all week. The Jets will not take the same approach in Week 11, ruling the rookie out a couple of days before the game. Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will lead the way for the Jets' route runners, as Isaiah Williams (ribs) has also been ruled out.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Isaiah Williams (ribs) out for Week 11
items.desc: Isaiah Williams (ribs) will not play Sunday against the Chargers.
items.impact: Williams has not practiced this week due to sore ribs. Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will lead the way for the Jets' receiving corps, as rookie wideout Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle/hip) has also been ruled out.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Geno Smith (ankle) practicing in full Friday
items.desc: Geno Smith (ankle) will practice in full on Friday.
items.impact: Smith was a limited participant at Thursday's practice session and will get in even more activity Friday. This suggests the veteran QB should be good to go for Sunday's matchup with the Chargers.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Dalton Schultz comes up with just one catch in Week 11 win
items.desc: Dalton Schultz caught his only target for 11 yards in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: For the second straight game, Schultz finished with one reception for 11 yards. His one catch ended up in the end zone last week, however. That was not the case Thursday night, as the veteran TE did very little for fantasy managers who rolled him out there. Schultz has a combined total of four grabs over the last three games, so he is difficult to trust for fantasy purposes right now.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Ka'imi Fairbairn puts six points on the board in Week 11 win
items.desc: Ka'imi Fairbairn made his only field-goal attempts and all three PATs in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Fairbairn remains one of the league's steadiest kickers. The 10-year veteran has missed just one of his 21 FG attempts this season, and that came all the way back in Week 2. He's also a perfect 27-of-27 on his PATs.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Texans D/ST dominates Colts on Thursday night
items.desc: The Texans' defense gave up only three points on 167 yards of offense, registering a pair of sacks and one interception in Thursday's 26-3 rout of the Colts.
items.impact: The Texans' defense has been anything but predictable through 10 games this season, but the unit was in peak form against a struggling Colts' offense Thursday night. The Texans completely bottled up star running back Jonathan Taylor while not allowing veteran QB Daniel Jones to do much either. The Texans picked up two sacks in this one, bringing their season total to 35 - currently second in the NFL. The Ravens are up next.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Colts D/ST comes up with one sack, one pick in Week 11 loss
items.desc: The Colts' defense allowed 24 points and 354 yards of offense, recording one sack and one interception in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: The Texans scored two of their points on a third-quarter safety Thursday night. The Colts' defense gave up the remaining 24 points. The Indy unit allowed three touchdowns through the air while also surrendering over 100 yards to returning running back David Montgomery. The Colts' defense is not one to target for fantasy purposes, giving up 27 points and more than 350 yards per game.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Spencer Shrader makes just 1-of-3 kicks Thursday night
items.desc: Spencer Shrader made 1-of-3 field-goal attempts and no PATs in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: Very little went right for the Colts on Thursday night, including in the kicking game. In Shrader's defense, he missed from 56 yards and had a 62-yard FG try blocked. The third-year kicker has actually been quite good overall this season, making 24-of-28 field-goal attempts and 19-of-20 PATs through 11 games.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tyler Warren hauls in one pass Thursday night
items.desc: Tyler Warren came up with just 1-of-5 targets for 22 yards in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: Warren's frustrating sophomore season in the NFL continued Thursday night. He did have a nice 22-yard gain, but other than that, he was shut down. Warren has managed only 11 total receptions over the last four games and has not scored since Week 2. The Colts' passing game is a mess right now, and Warren's fantasy value has greatly suffered as a result.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Baker Mayfield (foot) trending toward playing in Week 11
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (foot) is trending toward playing in Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Mayfield is dealing with a foot injury that kept him out of practice Wednesday, but the Tampa QB returned to the field in a limited capacity Thursday and is reportedly expected to give it a go Sunday. Mayfield's activity will still need to be monitored Friday. Jalon Daniels would be in line to start if Mayfield cannot go.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Ashton Dulin finishes with 30 yards on Thursday night
items.desc: Ashton Dulin caught 2-of-4 passes for 30 yards in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: Dulin has now gone for 30-plus yards in three straight weeks, averaging more than 28 yards on four total receptions in that span. He had a 25-yard gain in Thursday's game, and those big plays are his calling card. However, Dulin is a low-volume receiver in a struggling passing attack.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Laquon Treadwell puts up goose egg in Week 11
items.desc: Laquon Treadwell failed to catch his only target in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: After hauling in his first touchdown of the season in Sunday's win, Treadwell got shut out by the Texans' defense on Thursday. The Colts' passing game is simply not one to trust right now, as QB Daniel Jones has struggled to get much of anything going lately.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Anthony Gould finishes with 48 yards Thursday night
items.desc: Anthony Gould caught 2-of-3 targets for 48 yards in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: The Colts completed just 12 passes Thursday night, and Gould was one of three players on the team to catch more than one. The young slot receiver led the Colts in receiving yards and had the longest play on the team with a 31-yard gain. Gould is plenty involved in the offense, but the Colts' passing attack with QB Daniel Jones is just a mess right now.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Seth McGowan gets four touches, leaves with injury Thursday night
items.desc: Seth McGowan gained seven yards on three carries and just one yard on one catch before exiting Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: McGowan had been a bright spot for the struggling Colts in recent weeks, as the rookie back has looked like a capable ball carrier behind veteran Jonathan Taylor. Unfortunately, he sustained a hamstring injury after just a few touches Thursday night and did not return to the contest. McGowan has averaged an impressive 5.0 yards on his 58 total carries with two touchdowns so far this season. He's got plenty of fantasy value sharing the backfield with Taylor as long as the injury doesn't force him to miss time.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jonathan Taylor does very little with 15 touches Thursday night
items.desc: Jonathan Taylor gained 21 yards on 11 carries and just six yards on four receptions in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: Taylor had pretty much his worst game of the season Thursday night, as the Colts were dominated in all facets by the Texans. The star running back is stuck in an impotent offense with a team that is now 3-8 and looking to the future. Better games should still lay ahead, but the Colts may also decide to ease off Taylor's usage down the stretch.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Daniel Jones turns in another poor performance Thursday night
items.desc: Daniel Jones completed just 12-of-27 passes for 144 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: The Colts have stuck with Jones to this point, but that decision hasn't paid off. It could certainly be argued that the veteran QB has actually gotten worse at the helm of the Colts' offense as the season has progressed. Over the last two games, Jones has completed only 46.9% of his passes for 252 yards with a 1-3 TD/INT ratio. He's one to avoid in pretty much all fantasy formats.
